The '''advanced agent interface''' was a visor with an integrated [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and electronic analysis system. It was equipped to assist a user in covert operations with the ability to connect to a secure computer via cables. This physical link connected with an [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] enabling it to breach the system. The visor increased a being's ability with computers, mines, [[Droid/Legends|droid]] repair, breaking [[security lock]]s, and in sensing hostiles.
